_about: Wiki pages (wiki.leagueoflegends.com) used to fill in mechanics the game data lacks. 'changes' is the champion's last-changed patch in Module:ChampionData/data when checked; 'revision' pins the page text used; 'matched' lists numbers that agreed with our spell data (the cross-check). 'pages' are general pages used by hand-entered engine values (src/engine/hand.ts). Run `npm run wiki:check` before regenerating data for a new patch.
